# telnyx_integration_secrets (Data Source)

Lists integration secrets, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_integration_secret`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_type` (String) One of `basic`, `bearer`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `integration_secrets` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_secrets))
